thread:
alex_k: hitting a UI timeout on the Console when I try to save a model config. Page spins for ~30s then shows 502. Happening in Chrome and Edge.
maria_p: sorry about that — can you repro consistently? what browser versions & OS?
alex_k: yes, reproducible every time. Chrome 120.0.6096 on macOS 13.6.1. I can reproduce with devtools open.
ryan_devx: thanks. we'll need a HAR + console logs + the failing request ID. quick checklist below.
ryan_devx: 1) open DevTools > Network. Check "Preserve log" and "Disable cache". 2) reproduce the error so the failing request appears. 3) right-click the top of network list -> Save all as HAR with content. 4) Console tab -> right-click -> Save as "console.log" (or copy output). 5) locate our request header X-Request-Id or Redwood-ReqId in the failing request and paste it here.
alex_k: got it. HAR saved as "console_save_hang.har". Console saved to "console_save.txt". Header in request: Redwood-ReqId: rwd-8f3b2a9c
maria_p: perfect — please also capture the full request/response in devtools: click the failing request -> Headers -> Response and copy any stack traces or JSON error body.
ryan_devx: if you prefer a curl repro, you can right-click the request -> Copy -> Copy as fetch. Convert to curl like:
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/some-endpoint' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'Redwood-ReqId: rwd-8f3b2a9c' \
  --data-binary '{"foo":"bar"}' \
  --compressed
```
ryan_devx: remove any sensitive fields (auth tokens) before sharing. If you can't share tokens, just paste the Redwood-ReqId and we can look it up on our side.
alex_k: should I zip the two files and upload here?
support-bot: Case created: #SUP-6421. Please upload artifacts to the case using the support portal link: https://support.redwood.ai/cases/SUP-6421 or share a private Slack DM with @ryan_devx. :lock:
maria_p: one more thing — include a short repro step list (click Save -> choose model -> wait 25-30s -> 502). Also note if this occurs behind a corporate proxy/VPN.
alex_k: repro steps pasted in case description. Uploading zip now.
ryan_devx: thanks. once uploaded I'll pull logs from the backend for rwd-8f3b2a9c and correlate with infra traces. If we need a deeper trace we'll ask for a HAR with chrome://net-export or a full system trace, but usually network HAR + console + req id is enough.
alex_k: upload complete (SUP-6421/console_hang_2160012345.zip). :thumbsup:
maria_p: got it, I've attached to the ticket and added high priority. We'll update in the thread when we have findings. :eyes:
ryan_devx: quick tip for future captures: in Chrome you can also use "Network -> Save all as HAR with content" and enable "Record network logs while DevTools is closed" via the net-export page for cases where the issue only happens at page load. chrome://net-export/ has an option to capture events to a file.
alex_k: noted, thanks everyone.
support-bot: Status changed to Investigating on case #SUP-6421.
